title: athyrium serrulatum
intro: Athyrium serrulatum, commonly known as Lady Fern, is a deciduous fern species belonging to the Athyrium genus. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels, as well as its potential to inhibit the growth of certain bacteria and fungi. The therapeutic actions of Athyrium serrulatum include acting as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and diuretic, which can help to relieve symptoms of arthritis, kidney stones, and urinary tract infections. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
